Question 1
?

Consider a plane lamina of mass 6kg. If the moment of inertia of the lamina about an axis perpendicular to the lamina passing through its center of mass is 12.6kg⋅m2, what is the moment of inertia of the lamina about an axis parallel to the first passing through a point on the lamina at a distance of 1.2m from its center of mass?

a
24.32kg⋅m2
b
16.25kg⋅m2
c
28.21kg⋅m2
d
21.24kg⋅m2
e
14.84kg⋅m2
